Core

Button

Action button (or link styled as one) with 3 variants and 3 sizes. Class contract: .rse-button. Accepts every native attribute and a ref.

Live example

The example needs JavaScript; the usage below shows the markup.

Usage

Pill-shaped call-to-action button, the primary way people move through Rede Sesc de Educação surfaces (enroll, learn more, submit forms).

<Button variant="primary" size="md" onClick={() => {}}>Quero me inscrever</Button>
<Button variant="secondary">Saiba mais</Button>
<Button variant="ghost" size="sm">Voltar</Button>

Variants: primary (solid purple, on colored surfaces or as the main CTA), secondary (tinted purple, lower-emphasis actions), ghost (outlined, for use on busy or colored backgrounds). Sizes: sm, md, lg. Pass icon for a leading glyph; set disabled to mute and block interaction.

Pass href for navigation — it renders an <a> with the same look (a button that navigates is a link). Every native attribute and a ref pass through.

Without React: <button class="rse-button rse-button--secondary rse-button--sm"> or <a class="rse-button" href="/matricula">. Hover, press, focus and disabled are pure CSS.

Props

PropTypeRequiredNotes
variantprimary secondary ghost—Visual style
sizesm md lg—Size
iconReact.ReactNode—Optional leading icon element, usually an <Icon>
hrefstring—Renders an <a> that looks like a button. With disabled, the link is removed and aria-disabled set.
blockboolean—Full width
typebutton submit reset—
childrenReact.ReactNodeyes

Also accepts every attribute of Omit<React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, 'type'>, a ref and className.

Component tokens

Set any of these on :root or an ancestor to re-skin Button without touching its CSS. Each defaults to a role token, so it follows the theme. Use a role or palette token as the new value, and keep its pairs in scripts/contrast-pairs.mjs passing.

TokenDefaultLightDarkContrast
--rse-button-ghost-bg-hover{rse.color.surface-sunken}#f2f1ec#2e2d3b#f2f1ec
--rse-button-ghost-border{rse.color.border-strong}#84806f#7a7890#000000
--rse-button-ghost-fg{rse.color.text-on-primary-tint}#5e56ab#ad98ea#3a3186
--rse-button-primary-bg{rse.color.primary}#6c62c4#8e82d8#4a3fa8
--rse-button-primary-bg-active{rse.color.primary-active}#504a92#ad98ea#2c2566
--rse-button-primary-bg-hover{rse.color.primary-hover}#5e56ab#ad98ea#3a3186
--rse-button-primary-fg{rse.color.text-on-primary}#ffffff#171622#ffffff
--rse-button-radius{rse.radius.pill}999px999px999px
